items.question: Is the app secure? Does it access my broker?
items.answer: No. BrasilInvest Pro is 100% read-only. You import data via CSV or enter it manually. We never ask for broker passwords. We use bank-grade encryption (SSL 256-bit), Clerk for authentication and Supabase for data. We are GDPR Compliant for residents in Portugal.

items.question: How does the double taxation alert work?
items.answer: The app monitors the current laws of the Brazil-Portugal double taxation treaty and automatically calculates what must be declared in each country. You receive a ready monthly report, with values already separated for each filing. This avoids double charging and unnecessary fines.

items.question: Can I connect my Brazilian broker?
items.answer: We currently offer import via brokerage notes (PDF/CSV) and smart manual management. We are developing direct integration via Open Finance with XP, Rico and Clear — planned for the coming months.

items.question: Is the DRIP simulator accurate?
items.answer: The simulator uses real historical Dividend Yield of registered FIIs, live exchange rate and monthly compound reinvestment. Results are estimates based on real data — the market may vary, but the projection reflects the historical behavior of the assets.

items.question: Can I cancel the plan anytime?
items.answer: Yes. You can cancel at any time, without fines or bureaucracy. On the annual plan, you save 2 months and keep access until the end of the contracted period.

importNotes.title: Import Transactions
importNotes.subtitle: Drag your brokerage note PDFs (Sinacor standard) or CSV files of statements/exports from other platforms to import automatically.
importNotes.connectDesc: Use CSV/PDF exports from other platforms (Kinvo, TradeMap, Gorila, Real Valor, broker apps) to bring your data into Autoinvest without sharing passwords from those services.

b3.title: How to export from B3 (CSV):
steps: 1. Access the B3 portal or your broker's website (XP, Clear, Rico, Nubank).
2. Go to the transaction statement or trading history.
3. Export the CSV file with columns: Date, Movement, Ticker, Quantity, Price, Amount.
4. Import the CSV here. We will interpret buy/sell automatically.

kinvo.title: How to export from Kinvo:
steps: 1. Open Kinvo and go to Reports or Transaction History.
2. Choose the desired period and click Export.
3. Select the CSV format and save the file.
4. Import the CSV here. We will interpret type, ticker, quantity and amount.

trademap.title: How to export from TradeMap:
steps: 1. In the app or web, access your portfolio or statement.
2. Use the Export/Download as CSV option.
3. Save the file on your device and drag it to this screen.

gorila.title: How to export from Gorila:
steps: 1. Access your portfolio in Gorila.
2. Generate the transactions or position report in CSV.
3. Download the file and import it here.

realvalor.title: How to export from Real Valor:
steps: 1. Open Real Valor and go to portfolio/history.
2. Look for the option to export data in CSV.
3. Download and import the file on this screen.

broker.title: How to export from your broker:
steps: 1. Log in to the home broker or logged-in area.
2. Go to the trading statement or brokerage notes.
3. Use the export to CSV option (when available).
4. Alternatively, download the PDF notes and use the notes import.

generic.title: How to use another CSV:
steps: 1. Make sure the CSV has columns such as date, type, ticker, quantity, price and amount.
2. If the names follow this pattern, Autoinvest will try to map them automatically.

chat.topicDy:
**Dividend Yield (DY)** is the ratio between the dividends paid by a company and its share price.

Formula: `DY = (Annual Dividend / Price) x 100`

A DY of 6% means that for every R$ 100 invested, you receive R$ 6 per year in dividends.
chat.topicPrecoTeto:
**Ceiling Price** is the maximum recommended price to buy a stock, based on the Bazin method.

Formula: `Ceiling Price = DPS / 0.06`

Where DPS is the dividend per share over the last 12 months. If the current price is below the ceiling price, the asset is considered an opportunity.
chat.topicGraham:
**Graham's Formula** calculates the fair price of a stock.

Formula: `Price = Sqrt(22.5 x EPS x BVPS)`

Where EPS = Earnings Per Share and BVPS = Book Value Per Share. It's a conservative valuation method.
chat.topicBazin:
**Bazin Method** (or Barsi) defines the ceiling price for dividend stocks.

Formula: `Ceiling Price = DPS / 0.06`

It means you should only buy if the DY at your price is at least 6%. It's the main method of AutoInvest.
chat.topicCdi:
**CDI** (Interbank Deposit Certificate) is the benchmark rate for fixed income in Brazil.

Currently around ~13.25% per year. It's used as a benchmark: if your investment doesn't yield at least the CDI, it's losing to fixed income.
chat.topicSelic:
**Selic Rate** is the economy's basic interest rate, set by COPOM every 45 days.

It's the most important parameter for investments in Brazil. When Selic rises, fixed income becomes more attractive. When it falls, stocks and FIIs tend to appreciate.
chat.topicPvp:
**P/VP** (Price to Book Value) indicates whether an FII or stock is expensive or cheap vs its net worth.

P/VP = 1.0 means the price equals the book value. Below 1.0 may indicate a discount. For FIIs, P/VP < 0.85 is generally considered good.
chat.topicPl:
**P/L** (Price to Earnings) indicates in how many years the investment pays for itself with the company's earnings.

P/L = 10 means the company earns 10% of its market value per year. P/L between 5 and 15 is generally considered fair for mature companies.
chat.topicMagicNumber:
**Magic Number** is the number of shares needed for an asset's dividends to buy 1 additional share per year.

Formula: `Magic Number = 1 / DY`

Example: If the DY is 8%, you need ~12.5 shares for the "snowball effect". The sooner you reach it, the faster your wealth grows.
chat.topicBolaDeNeve:
**Snowball Effect** is the reinvestment of dividends to buy more shares, generating more dividends in the future.

It's the fundamental principle of passive income: it starts slow, but after 5-10 years the curve becomes exponential. AutoInvest automatically tracks your progress via the Magic Number.
chat.topicStreak:
**Streak** is the sequence of consecutive months with contributions. Keeping a long streak shows discipline and is one of the Health Score pillars.

3+ months: Good
6+ months: Very good
12+ months: Excellent!
chat.topicHealthScore:
**Health Score** is a 0-100 score that evaluates the health of your portfolio across 4 pillars:

1. **Diversification** (25%): Number of assets and distribution by category
2. **Yield** (25%): Average DY of the portfolio
3. **Valuation** (25%): % of assets below ceiling price
4. **Discipline** (25%): Contribution regularity (streak)
